newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sterling Eurobond roadshow set for July 4.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sterling Eurobond roadshow set for July 4.

text.p: Central Bank International Affairs Director Gustavo Franco will travel to London on Friday to meet with investors prior to launching Brazil's 150-200 million sterling Eurobond, a bank spokeswoman said.
The 10-year bond, to be led by Barclays de Zoete Wedd and CS First Boston, was expected to price at a spread of 250-275 basis points over gilts.
Franco has been in Italy since July 1. Brazil on Wednesday added 250 billion lire to its 11 percent 500 billion lire 20-year bond ZYBB which it priced in early June.
No other European stops were scheduled for Franco, the spokeswoman said.
